title: high-precision replication of the seed1879 layer-2 Memory route
status: frozen-checkpoint confidence-interval confirmation on a new panel
motivation: Level 7.3 localized seed1879's necessary route to layer 2, but the keep-L2 95% Wilson interval crossed the 90% sufficiency threshold.
hypothesis: The frozen seed1879 checkpoint has a high-precision L2-dominant persistent-Memory route: L2 is necessary, sample-aligned, and sufficient by a 95% Wilson lower-bound criterion, whereas L3 is neither necessary nor sufficient.

frozen_source.selection: none; the single source was fixed by the Level 7.3 result

confidence_rule: All primary gates use two-sided 95% Wilson intervals evaluated at the fixed N=8192 endpoint.

registered_gates.local_behavior: minimum local Wilson lower bound across conditions >= 0.90
registered_gates.whole_memory_causality: reset-all, zero-all, and batch-roll-all query Wilson upper bounds <= 0.20
registered_gates.L3_nonnecessity_contrast: zero-L3 and batch-roll-L3 query Wilson lower bounds >= 0.80

registered_classification.l2_route_supported_but_single_layer_suff: all gates except the keep-L2 Wilson-lower gate pass, and keep-L2 point accuracy remains >= 0.90

precision_rationale: Near 91% accuracy, N=8192 approximately halves the Wilson half-width observed at N=2048 and can distinguish a stable approximately 91% effect from the 90% lower-bound claim without optional stopping.
stop_rule: Report the fixed high-precision classification; do not add samples, conditions, alternative checkpoints, or a training repair after observing results.
